examples.title: Example 1: Allowing Drag and Drop
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use allowDrop to configure component drop targets and draggable to enable component dragging.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Drag Preview
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure the preview displayed during the drag process using dragPreview.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Drag Preview Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure the drag preview style using dragPreviewOptions. Set ENABLE_DEFAULT_SHADOW and ENABLE_DEFAULT_RADIUS for default shadow and unified rounded corner effects. Starting from API version 18, set dragPreviewOptions to ENABLE_DRAG_ITEM_GRAY_EFFECT to enable grayscale effects on the original drag item.

examples.title: Example 4: Enabling the Multi-select Drag Functionality
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure isMultiSelectionEnabled to enable the multi-select drag functionality in the Grid component.

examples.title: Example 5: Enabling the Default Pressed State Animation
examples.description: This example demonstrates configuring defaultAnimationBeforeLifting to enable the default press animation effect in the Grid component.

examples.title: Example 6: Customizing the Preview Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates customizing the Image component background by configuring ImageModifier.

examples.title: Example 7: Configuring Image Dragging Settings
examples.description:
This example demonstrates drag configuration for different image types (online resources, local resources, and PixelMap).
The ohos.permission.INTERNET permission is required for using online images. For details about how to apply for a permission, see Declaring Permissions.

examples.title: Example 8: Enabling Haptic Feedback for Dragging
examples.description: This example demonstrates enabling haptic feedback during image drag operations by configuring enableHapticFeedback, supported since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 9: Customizing the Drag Preview
examples.description: Starting from API version 15, this example configures onlyForLifting to create a custom preview image exclusively for the lift animation effect, and isLiftingDisabled to disable the lift animation effect.

examples.title: Example 10: Implementing Touch Point Calculation Based on Initial Drag Preview Size
examples.description: This example configures DragPreviewMode as ENABLE_TOUCH_POINT_CALCULATION_BASED_ON_FINAL_PREVIEW to calculate touch point positions using the initial drag preview size, supported since API version 19. This setting has no effect when DragPreviewMode is set to ENABLE_MULTI_TILE_EFFECT.

examples.title: Example 11: Implementing Transition Effects Between Floating Images and Drag Previews
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement different transition effects between floating images and drag previews by configuring DraggingSizeChangeEffect, supported since API version 19.

examples.title: Example 12: Setting Dropping of a Custom Component
examples.description: In API version 23 and later, this example demonstrates how to implement the drag-and-drop function for a custom component by passing a type through the component's onDragStart API and setting the target component's allowDrop attribute to allow dropping of that type.
